Increase the relative odds of Rare and Legendary shop offers by 50%.

8-related point awards and growth, Bear/Bull Market cash, Moai matches, Crystal Ball progress, and Octopus payouts have a 68% chance to trigger twice. Each additional copy reduces the chance of no extra trigger by 68%.
For every nine 9s seen, reserve a Legendary trinket for a future shop. One reservation is used per shop; progress carries between spins.
Score 100 points if your number ends in two zeroes.
Reduce the relative odds of rolling a 6 by 90%.
Score the product of each adjacent three-digit sequence increasing or decreasing by 1. Overlapping sequences count.
Score the product of each complete adjacent sequence of at least four digits increasing or decreasing by 1.
Increase the relative odds of Rare and Legendary tools in the shop by 50%.
If your last number is lower than your first number, gain $20 and score 40 points.
If your last number is higher than your first number, gain $20 and score 40 points.
Score my current power, starting at 77. If your final number is divisible by 7, permanently add 77 power for future activations.
For every eight 8s seen, gain a random unowned non-Token trinket, ignoring rarity. Progress carries between spins.
Score my current power, starting at 121. If your final number is divisible by 11, permanently double my power for future activations.
Score my current power, starting at 13. If your final number is divisible by 3, permanently add 13 power for future activations.
Doubles your points if you have no 4s and have at least one 8.

Score 25 points if your number is divisible by 5.
Score 12 points for every zero.
If you have 6 of the same value, score 1000 points.
If all your numbers are strictly increasing or decreasing, score 456 points.

After each spin is scored, gain a random tool you do not own, ignoring rarity. Does nothing if you own every tool.
Reroll tools have +3 uses each spin.

Score the password to transform every copy in this visible stack and its neighboring stacks into random unowned trinkets one rarity higher. Legendary stays Legendary. Skips Tokens and Falling Leaves; exhausted pools produce Bug. Neighbors do not wrap.
When you enter a shop, gain 10% of your cash balance, rounded down.
Picks a favorite number from your reels when you spin. Multiplies your points this round by 3 EVERY time it scores its favorite number.
Scores +24 points no matter what you spin.
If your numbers sum to 21, triple your score this round.
Double your score if you have at least three of one digit and at least two of a different digit.
Score 8 times the sum of all your digits.
Each 1 scores my current power, then permanently adds 5 power. Starts at 1 power.
Score 50 points per trinket copy you own, including this one.
Shop rerolls cost 2 less.
If you have two zeroes that aren't next to each other, score 21 times your highest digit.

Double the relative odds of rolling a 7.
When I see an 8, gain $8. Each eight 8s seen this round reduces this payout by $1, to a minimum of $0. Resets each round.
Score 88 points if you have at least one digit and equal counts of odd and even digits. Grey slots are ignored.
Each shop offers a copy of a random trinket you own at double its normal price. Cannot print Printer, Tokens, or Bug.
Add 30% of this round's goal, rounded up, after ordinary score multipliers and before The Silent.
Shops have one more tool upgrade.
Shops have one more trinket.
Multiplies your score by 4 for every grey (non-numeric) slot.
What did you do? (Scores for 2560 points)
Quadruple the relative odds of Rare and Legendary tool upgrades in the shop.
Score my current power, starting at 101 (5 in decimal). Each 0 or 1 seen permanently adds 10 (2 in decimal) power.
Scores 666 points when you score 3 consecutive 6s.
If you didn't use any tools this round, score 120 points.

Copy only the point-scoring abilities and score multipliers of your Common and Uncommon trinkets. Does not copy cash, rewards, or passive bonuses, including through Fax Machine.
Each copy adds a shop slot reserved for Experiments. Experiments you already own can appear again in shops.
After other trinkets resolve, multiply your score by 1.1 for each other eligible trinket copy that did not activate this round. Excludes passive abilities, shop-only abilities, and The Silent itself.
Become Dormant II when you have the abilities of Brainrot I, II, and III.
Score six 7s to become Ultimate Brainrot. While owned, prevents random Dormant I rewards and transformations; direct copies are still allowed.
Multiply your score by 67 for each adjacent 67 in your number.
Copy one trinket's abilities from the next visible stack to the right. Does nothing at the right edge; copying loops are skipped.
If the goal is met before The Silent applies, add 30% of the base goal cash reward. Stacks additively with Confetti Horn and Life of the Party. Does not increase W bonuses.
If the goal is met before The Silent applies, add 70% of the base goal cash reward. Stacks additively with Confetti Horn and Life of the Party. Does not increase W bonuses.
You Got the Dud! (Creates a new Dud after every spin.)
For every three 3s scored, gain a random unowned Uncommon or Rare trinket. Progress carries between spins.
After each spin, gain +$60. Reduce the payout by $6 each time you've used a tool this spin (min. $0).

When acquired, gain a random Rare tool you do not own. Does nothing if you own every Rare tool.
After each spin, gain $10. Cannot be copied by Replication Experiment.
When a trinket transforms, gain +$30. Cannot transform.
